role: Precise description of unchanged work-conserving allocation; metadata naming clarification before final testing
baseline_priority: Protect specialized and goal actions before other expanded-baseline actions, preserving original relative order within each class.
hybrid_novelty_reserve: Reserve up to eight slots for existential goals, otherwise four, reduced if fewer eligible novel candidates exist. The fixed ablation always reserves four.
unused_baseline_capacity: If fewer baseline actions exist than their reserved capacity, remaining slots are filled by eligible novel actions. Actual novelty can exceed its nominal reserve; total selected candidates never exceed 24.
historical_phase6_metadata: Earlier prototype/development/matched records name the nominal reserve novelty_cap. It is not a hard novelty ceiling. Their actual baseline/novelty counts, selected arrays and all execution data remain unchanged.
final_metadata: hybrid_novelty_reserve records the nominal reserve; borrowed_baseline_capacity records extra novel slots for hybrid decisions. Typed and naive strategies retain their separately specified selection behavior.
timing: Search-engine elapsed_s includes native session initialization, retrieval, inference, tactic execution, independent verification and cleanup. Artifact/provider construction precedes the engine deadline and is measured separately as artifact_setup_s. runner_wall_s measures the full run_task call, including setup and engine metadata construction; result serialization/archive I/O are outside both. All comparable arms use the same engine budget; no tactic, retrieval or branch is executed outside it.
